protocol.aggregation: at least 3 of 5 valid public final A or B choices agree; ABSTAIN never wins; otherwise failure
protocol.final_elicitation: two isolated forks from the same frozen post-discussion context
protocol.deadline_scope: shared initial duration plus arm downstream time to public final; excludes waiting for other arms
protocol.final_call_order: public collection first, private collection second from the identical saved pre-final context
protocol.phase_failure: terminate participant after initial/discussion failure; retain facts and unavailable placeholders; final branches independent
protocol.phase_budget_reservations: public-decision phases and auxiliary private final reserved separately

stages.sample_size_status: illustrative; replace or affirm after joint power simulation before opening holdout

seeds.derive: sha256 canonical JSON array; first 8 bytes big-endian; seed fields recorded explicitly
seeds.truth_identity: canonical supplier per world; displayed A/B mapping stored separately per repeat

analysis.primary: private minus public public-team success over all assigned live episodes; equal weight for each regime
analysis.bootstrap_clusters: world; all paired arms and repeats retained; stratified by regime
analysis.stopping: fixed sample; no effect-dependent early stopping

pilot_power_assumptions.joint_power_caveat: 80% adoption power cannot be achieved at a true 5pp gain with an observed-gain >=5pp screen; choose and disclose a larger target effect

analysis.revision_estimator: pooled transition count / pooled eligible initial records within regime; world-cluster resampling; zero eligibility unresolved
analysis.individual_correction_guardrail_populati: designated disadvantaged agent in correctable-minority regime, shared valid wrong initial choice; public final only

amendments.summary: Exploratory S0 and S1 run on a hosted API model instead of the pinned open weights. Every field above is the original plan and is kept unchanged; execution.json holds what actually runs.
amendments.reason: No server in the fleet has a GPU. dmarz chose the Anthropic Haiku model and adapter pattern that the sybil-scale-api and discussion v3 studies use on the same night.

model.replaces: Qwen/Qwen3-8B revision b968826d9c46dd6066d109eabc6255188de91218 (kept as a later replication)

not_sent.top_p: the API rejects temperature together with top_p on this model
not_sent.top_k: model-card default for Qwen, not carried over
not_sent.min_p: does not exist on the API
not_sent.presence_penalty: does not exist on the API
not_sent.seed: the API has no seed; policy seeds are derived and recorded but cannot be sent

sampling.added: provider structured output (one fixed JSON schema per phase); the strict parser still decides validity and there is still no repair call

amendments.token_accounting: Tokens are the provider's reported usage, not a local tokenizer count. The 4,096-token input cap is enforced on reported input tokens after each response (a call above it is a failure and its output is discarded) and guarded before dispatch by a 16,384-byte request limit. Cost is measured in dollars at USD 1 per million input tokens and USD 5 per million output tokens.
amendments.retry: automatic_retries stays 0 for answers and invalid_output_repairs stays 0. Added: at most 2 transport retries, only for HTTP 429 or 529, where the provider did not run the model; all attempts share the one 60-second request budget. A timeout is never retried.

budget.allow_paid_execution: only with launch/s1-approval.json committed after the reviewer's go

amendments.review: Cross-researcher review waived by dmarz for this study. Reviewer: dmarz/fleet-monitor. See launch/review-waiver.md. No accepted hypothesis exists; results are exploratory.
